en: Black‑and‑white elevated view over a small European town in a narrow valley. A straight tree‑lined road runs through the middle, flanked by early‑20th‑century houses with steep tiled roofs and dormer windows. The town is surrounded by wooded hills and terraced fields; there is a factory chimney in the distance and many private gardens in the foreground. No printed caption or text is visible on the image.
